title: A dice and card simulator
description:
Answer probability questions by simulation, with your own random number generator.

```
seed 2026, 1,000,000 trials each
two dice sum to 7:            16.67% (exact 16.67%)
a poker hand has a pair:      42.26%
23 people share a birthday:   50.73%
shuffles are fair: every first card seen 1/52 of the time (largest error 0.2%)
```
hints: Represent a card as a number from 0 to 51: `card % 13` is the rank and `card / 13` the suit.
The result's accuracy grows with the square root of the trials; print how many you ran.
requirements: An xorshift generator in a struct, seeded from the command line, with a fair `rng_below` (lesson 8.06).
A Fisher-Yates shuffle of a 52-card deck, and at least three questions answered by simulation.
Every result printed with the number of trials; for questions with a known exact answer, print it too.
stretch: Find the probability of a flush and compare it with the exact value.
